reuse.why: Calls the shared assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere guard, findOrCreateBank and handleSyncResponse, but the link flow and the transaction download are copied from the SimpleFin/Akahu versions instead of being shared or parameterised.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount/linkSimpleFinAccount (~70 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with only the server key and log text changed.

placement.why: New code sits where each provider's pieces live (accounts/app.ts, accounts/sync.ts, server-config.ts, SYNC_PROVIDERS in bank-sync.ts).

scope.why: Focused on the server side; the two desktop-client edits are the minimum needed to satisfy types keyed by the extended SYNC_PROVIDERS list.

maintainability.why: Follows the tree's existing one-copy-per-provider convention, so it is easy to read, but it adds two more copies that must be kept in step with the others on any change to linking or downloading.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of the link handler and the download function are plain, recognisable copies with only provider names and server keys changed.
